name: Kickbox
summary: Single email verification with result, reason, Sendex quality score, role, free, disposable and accept-all flags and typo suggestions, plus a free disposable-domain check.

host.description: API host: the default, or api.eu.kickbox.com for an EU-only account (one that signs in at app.eu.kickbox.com).

api_key.description: A Kickbox API key (app.kickbox.com > API Keys > Add). Sent as a Bearer token; the apikey query parameter also works.

notes: Up to 25 parallel requests per IP and 8,000 requests per clock minute; a 429 can be retried at once.
Each response carries X-Kickbox-Balance (verification credits left) and X-Kickbox-Response-Time headers.

A sandbox key verifies without using credits and returns mock results (deliverable unless the address names another outcome, such as rejected-email@example.com); a key is created as sandbox or production and cannot switch.

endpoints.name: Verify one email
endpoints.summary: Result (deliverable, undeliverable, risky, unknown), reason, Sendex score from 0 to 1, role, free, disposable and accept_all flags, did_you_mean suggestion and the normalized address.

timeout.description: Maximum time for the verification in milliseconds; default 6000, maximum 30000.

notes: Uses a verification credit. Reasons: invalid_email, invalid_domain, rejected_email, accepted_email, low_quality, low_deliverability, no_connect, timeout, invalid_smtp, unavailable_smtp, unexpected_error.
An unknown result means the mail server did not answer in time; retrying after about 5 minutes often resolves it.
success false with a message (invalid API key, balance depleted, rate limit exceeded) is a request failure, not a verification result.

endpoints.name: Check if an email or domain is disposable
endpoints.summary: Whether an address or domain is hosted by a known disposable email service.

address.description: The email address or domain to check.

notes: Free and open: needs no key and uses no credits.
